title: The Cancer Drug That Was Radioactive—and FDA-Approved
hook: A chemotherapy drug approved by the FDA was later found to be literally radioactive, giving patients a second cancer while treating the first.
why_this_can_go_viral: The phrase 'radioactive cancer drug' triggers immediate shock and disbelief, driving clicks and shares.

title: The Doctor Who Killed 50 Patients—and Became a CEO
hook: A physician who caused the deaths of dozens by prescribing a dangerous 'natural' remedy later became the CEO of a billion-dollar health company.
why_this_can_go_viral: The rags-to-riches story gone murderous is irresistible, especially when the system rewards the offender.

title: The Suppressed Cure: Garlic Extract That Killed MRSA
hook: A cheap garlic compound that killed antibiotic-resistant superbugs in lab tests was buried after a pharmaceutical company bought the patent and shelved it.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'they don't want us to be healthy' narrative plus a simple kitchen ingredient is pure viral fuel.

title: The Pharmaceutical Company That Sold a Drug That Melted Organs
hook: A popular diabetes drug caused patients' internal organs to literally liquefy—and the company knew about the deaths for years before recalling it.
why_this_can_go_viral: The phrase 'melted organs' is deeply graphic and unforgettable, ensuring high shareability.

title: The Experiment Where Doctors Sewed Eyes Shut to Test 'Restricted Vision'
hook: In a secret 1950s experiment, doctors sewed the eyes of orphaned children shut for weeks to study 'visual deprivation'—no anesthesia, no consent.
why_this_can_go_viral: The image of sewing eyes shut on children is visceral horror—pure emotional shock that drives shares.

title: The Hospital That Used Patients as Morgue Attendants for Profit
hook: A major hospital forced living patients to work in the morgue handling corpses to cut costs—and billed them for the 'therapy'.
why_this_can_go_viral: The absurd and macabre combination of patient-as-morgue-worker is bizarre enough to guarantee curiosity.

title: The FDA-Approved Eye Drops That Destroyed Corneas
hook: A brand of lubricating eye drops was approved by the FDA—and caused blindness in hundreds of users by eating away their corneas from the inside.
why_this_can_go_viral: Eye drops are a trivial purchase—the shock of them causing blindness makes people question everything they use.

title: The Suppressed Cure: How a Weed-Killer Became a Cancer Miracle
hook: A common agricultural herbicide showed miraculous effects against pancreatic cancer—until a pharmaceutical giant bought the formula and locked it in a vault.
why_this_can_go_viral: The irony of a weed-killer curing cancer while a corporation buries it is dark and rage-inducing.

title: The Disease Cover-Up: They Knew the Non-Stick Pan Caused Thyroid Cancer
hook: Documents revealed that Teflon chemicals caused thyroid tumors in 100% of lab animals—the company continued selling for 20 more years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Almost every kitchen has a non-stick pan—this turns a mundane object into a health threat.

title: The Pharmaceutical Company That Paid Pharmacists to Push Addictive Drugs
hook: A drug maker secretly paid pharmacists a bonus for every prescription of an addictive opioid they filled—creating thousands of addicts in one city.
why_this_can_go_viral: The direct pipeline from corporate greed to community addiction is a powerful, shareable indictment.

title: The Doctor Who Harvested Stillborn Babies Without Consent
hook: For 15 years, a respected OB-GYN removed organs from stillborn babies and sold them to research firms—without ever telling the grieving parents.
why_this_can_go_viral: The combination of grief, betrayal, and bodily integrity violation is deeply emotional and shareable.

title: The Experiment That Made Patients Breathe Pure Acid for 24 Hours
hook: In a US Army-funded study, patients were forced to inhale concentrated hydrochloric acid mist—many never recovered their lung function.
why_this_can_go_viral: The sheer cruelty and the 'acid breathing' image are extreme enough to grab any scroller.

title: The Toxic Makeup That Caused Paralysis in Women
hook: A luxury lipstick line contained a neurotoxin that caused partial facial paralysis in hundreds of women—the company blamed 'allergic reactions'.
why_this_can_go_viral: Makeup is a daily essential for millions—the idea of it paralyzing you is instantly terrifying.

title: The Hospital That Charged Patients for 'Fertility' They Didn't Request
hook: A hospital secretly added fertility treatments to patient bills without their knowledge—then sued them when they refused to pay the thousands.
why_this_can_go_viral: The Kafkaesque horror of being charged for something you never agreed to resonates with everyone who fears medical bills.

title: The Suppressed Cure: How a Mushroom Extract Cured Hepatitis C for $10
hook: A mushroom compound cleared Hepatitis C in clinical trials at a cost of $10 per dose—a pharmaceutical company paid the patent holder to never publish the results.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'natural vs. corporate' narrative with a staggeringly cheap cure is a guaranteed viral formula.

title: The Disease Cover-Up: They Knew the Carpet Chemical Caused Leukemia in Kids
hook: A chemical used in stain-resistant carpets was linked to childhood leukemia—the manufacturer suppressed the data and sold carpets for 25 more years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Every parent wants to protect their kids—learning a household product causes leukemia is a viral trigger.

title: The Pharmaceutical Company That Sold a Drug That Made Bones Grow Inside Eyes
hook: An osteoporosis drug caused patients to grow bone spurs inside their eyeballs, causing blindness—the company hid the side effect for 7 years.
why_this_can_go_viral: The grotesque and science-fiction-like image of bones growing in eyeballs is impossible to look away from.

title: The Doctor Who Diagnosed Dead Patients to Bill Insurance
hook: A family physician filed insurance claims for medical procedures performed on patients who had been dead for years—and collected millions before anyone noticed.
why_this_can_go_viral: The darkly comedic 'zombie patient' angle is absurd enough to get clicks and shares.

title: The FDA-Approved Arthritis Patch That Caused Heart Explosions
hook: A pain patch for arthritis was linked to sudden cardiac death in young patients—the FDA approved it despite knowing the risk of fatal arrhythmias.
why_this_can_go_viral: The phrase 'heart explosion' is hyper-specific and shocking, driving immediate clicks.

title: The Suppressed Cure: How a Common Vitamin Stopped a Polio Epidemic—and Was Buried
hook: Vitamin B1 injections stopped a polio outbreak in a small town in 1948—but the medical establishment suppressed the data and pushed the vaccine instead.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'cheap vitamin vs. big medicine' David-vs-Goliath story is timeless and shareable.
